messages.content: Write one concise customer-service reply using only the supplied policy facts. State an action only when action_committed is true.

Customer request: My blender arrived damaged. Please refund it.
Facts: {'order_id': 'ORD-0008', 'requested_resolution': 'cash refund', 'allowed': True, 'amount': '149', 'reason': 'The refund is within $200 and 30 days of delivery.', 'alternative': None, 'action_committed': True}

response.text: Hi, I'm sorry your blender arrived damaged. Your request for a cash refund on order ORD-0008 has been approved, and the refund of $149 has been processed. It qualified because it falls within our $200 limit and 30-day window from delivery. Thank you for your patience.
